summary: Parked-up residential kerb, nearest homes about 24 m away, mild slope.
reasons: Homes about 24 m away, flats all round

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwelling 24 m (at 50 m); police station about 22-28 m; flats and houses both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both kerbs; room to pull in.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

flags: Steep: about 4.5% at the best section, 3.4% mean over the stretch
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy on the south side and from the north building.

best_section.where: South kerb of Vincent Street beside the small car park and trees
